ownership_findings.subject: business-object semantic ownership
ownership_findings.finding: The public catalog describes API-owned canonical business objects and deterministic truth, while the systems program assigns business truth to Postgres/providers and the pending control plane preserves existing UI object ownership until explicit transfer.
ownership_findings.required_convergence: API_SE_003 must assign store, mutation owner and readback per object; API_SE_002 must keep the public catalog from expressing stronger ownership than that registry.

ownership_findings.subject: P110/P111 ownership transfer
ownership_findings.finding: Main reads P110/P111 as canonical but deliberately does not carry their migration or completed ownership transfer; PR #31 proposes a transfer registry but is unmerged.
ownership_findings.required_convergence: Do not claim API migration ownership until migration history and production ownership evidence are reconciled.

ownership_findings.subject: workflow-pack duplicate definitions
ownership_findings.finding: Nine workflow packs are independently defined in TypeScript and SQL; tests validate TypeScript against capabilities but do not prove parity with the SQL seed.
ownership_findings.required_convergence: Select one canonical definition or add generated/checksummed parity before either surface is treated as authoritative.

ownership_findings.subject: readiness semantic split
ownership_findings.finding: readyz can return READY after select 1 and configuration checks while healthz returns 503 unless the RLS posture also passes.
ownership_findings.required_convergence: API_SE_007 and API_SE_011 must name these as distinct observations or converge one readiness rule.

ownership_findings.subject: provider connected status
ownership_findings.finding: Gmail, Google Drive and Airtable are labelled CONNECTED from stored connection counts without current provider reachability/readback.
ownership_findings.required_convergence: API_SE_007 must separate desired/configured, credential-ready, observed and reconciled provider state.

ownership_findings.subject: identity and tenant transition
ownership_findings.finding: The service-token boundary accepts tenant/actor headers; Vercel OIDC pins only the Luzione UI workload and tenant. Canonical membership resolution is pending in PR #31.
ownership_findings.required_convergence: API_SE_004 must preserve current compatibility without allowing caller-supplied authority to become canonical identity.

ownership_findings.subject: mutation endpoint overlap
ownership_findings.finding: Main exposes an unauthenticated, fail-closed POST placeholder while PR #31 introduces the governed command path.
ownership_findings.required_convergence: Retire or explicitly compatibility-map the placeholder when the command contract is adopted.

ownership_findings.subject: catalog evidence labels
ownership_findings.finding: The catalog labels developer/OpenAPI and other planned concepts as foundation even though main has no OpenAPI route or shared compatibility registry.
ownership_findings.required_convergence: API_SE_002 must publish explicit contract versions and evidence maturity instead of broad foundation labels.

ownership_findings.subject: canonical object inventory completeness
ownership_findings.finding: The current object list omits Supplier, Quote, Product, Task, Approval, Decision, Workflow, Memory and AI Generation from the program's required initial truth inventory.
ownership_findings.required_convergence: API_SE_003 must inventory these without inventing owners where repository evidence is absent.

pending_change_sets.scope: integrated authority-v2 control plane, connections, commands, durable execution, webhook runtime, learning and constitutional ledgers, migration runner and release/load evidence
pending_change_sets.convergence_rule: reuse after rebase/reconciliation; do not copy its runtime or migration ownership claims into main metadata as implemented

strongest_claim.claim: The tracked main-branch API topology, route surface, direct store/provider boundaries, health/evidence sources, pending API change sets and visible semantic conflicts are inventoried and coverage-checked for API_SE_001. Consumer repository internals and live production/provider state remain unverified.
